CREATE DATABASE GoldAnalyticsDB;
GO
USE GoldAnalyticsDB;
GO
-- 2. Create Logical View Over Gold Delta Lake
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW vw_fact_invoices AS
SELECT 
    invoice_id,
    subscription_id,
    invoice_amount,
    currency,
    payment_status,
    payment_method,
    due_date,
    invoice_date,
    collected_amount,
    overdue_amount
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://sadatapulse360lak.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/fact_invoices/',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS [result];
GO
-- 3. Test View Query
SELECT * FROM vw_fact_invoices;
GO

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS unique_invoices
FROM vw_fact_invoices;
